lg-group.name: LG Group
lg-group.description: LG Corporation is a South Korean multinational conglomerate headquartered in Seoul. Founded in 1947, it develops, manufactures, and markets electronics, chemicals, household appliances, and telecommunications products through subsidiaries worldwide.

luxottica.name: Luxottica
luxottica.description: Luxottica Group S.p.A. was an Italian eyewear multinational headquartered in Milan. It designs, manufactures, distributes, and retails eyewear brands and is the largest eyewear company globally. Since 2018, it has been a subsidiary of EssilorLuxottica after a merger.

lukoil.name: Lukoil
lukoil.description: PJSC Lukoil is a Russian multinational energy corporation headquartered in Moscow. It specializes in extraction, production, transport, and sale of petroleum, natural gas, petroleum products, and electricity.

lufthansa-group.name: Lufthansa Group
lufthansa-group.description: Deutsche Lufthansa AG, trading as Lufthansa Group, is a German aviation holding company. Its principal airline, Lufthansa German Airlines, is the flag carrier of Germany. Lufthansa Group is a founding member of Star Alliance, the world's largest airline alliance.

life-insurance-corporation-of-india.name: Life Insurance Corporation of India
life-insurance-corporation-of-india.description: The Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) is an Indian public sector life insurance company headquartered in Mumbai. It is India's largest insurance company and institutional investor, owned by the Government of India and under the Ministry of Finance's control.

lg-electronics.name: LG Electronics
lg-electronics.description: LG Electronics Inc. is a South Korean multinational major appliance and consumer electronics corporation headquartered in Seoul. It is part of LG Corporation and comprises four business units including Home Appliance and Media Entertainment Solutions. The company operates in wholesale trade of household appliances.

linde-group.name: Linde Group
linde-group.description: Linde plc is a global multinational chemical company and the world's largest industrial gas supplier. Founded in 1879 in Germany, it is now headquartered in Woking, UK, and registered in Ireland. Linde plc was formed in 2018 through the merger of Linde AG and Praxair.

lenovo.name: Lenovo
lenovo.description: Lenovo Group Limited is a Hong Kong–based Chinese multinational technology company specializing in designing, manufacturing, and marketing consumer electronics, personal computers, and enterprise infrastructure solutions. Its global headquarters are in Beijing, China, and Morrisville, North Carolina, USA. Lenovo owns the smartphone brand Motorola.

lafarge.name: Lafarge
lafarge.description: Lafarge is a French industrial company specializing in cement, construction aggregates, and concrete. Founded in 1833, it is the world's largest cement manufacturer and is part of the Holcim Group.

lenta.name: Lenta
lenta.description: Lenta is a Russian retail chain operating super- and hypermarkets with 149 locations across Russia. It is one of the country's largest retail chains and the second largest hypermarket chain. The company is based in Russia.

latam-airlines-group.name: LATAM Airlines Group
latam-airlines-group.description: LATAM Airlines is a Chilean multinational airline headquartered in Santiago, Chile. It is the largest airline holding company in Latin America with subsidiaries in Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador, Paraguay, and Peru.

legrand.name: Legrand
legrand.description: Legrand S.A. is a French industrial group historically based in Limoges, Nouvelle-Aquitaine region. It operates in the industrial sector and is headquartered in France.

lkq-corporation.name: LKQ Corporation
lkq-corporation.description: LKQ Corporation is an American provider of alternative and specialty parts for repairing and accessorizing automobiles and other vehicles. It operates in North America, Europe, and Taiwan, selling replacement systems, components, and parts.

lehman-brothers.name: Lehman Brothers
lehman-brothers.description: Lehman Brothers Holdings Inc. was an American global financial services firm founded in 1850. It was the fourth-largest investment bank in the U.S. before filing for bankruptcy in 2008. Lehman operated in investment banking, trading, research, investment management, private equity, and private banking.

lifan-group.name: Lifan Group
lifan-group.description: Lifan Industry (Group) Co., Ltd. is a civilian-owned Chinese manufacturer of motorcycles and automobiles headquartered in Chongqing. Founded in 1992, it began automobile production in 2005 with license-built microvans and a small sedan.

lululemon-athletica.name: Lululemon Athletica
lululemon-athletica.description: Lululemon Athletica is a Canadian-American multinational athletic apparel retailer headquartered in Vancouver, British Columbia. Founded in 1998, it started as a retailer of yoga pants and yoga wear and has expanded to include sportswear, lifestyle apparel, shoes, accessories, and personal care products. The company operates 811 stores and sells products online.

lanxess.name: Lanxess
lanxess.description: Lanxess AG is a German specialty chemicals company based in Cologne, Germany. It was founded in 2004 following the spin-off of Bayer AG's chemicals division and parts of its polymers business. The company operates in the chemical industry.

legal-general.name: Legal & General
legal-general.description: Legal & General Group plc is a British multinational financial services and asset management company headquartered in London, England. It offers investment management, lifetime mortgages, pensions, annuities, and life insurance. The company sold its general insurance business to Allianz in 2020.

l-occitane-en-provence.name: L'Occitane en Provence
l-occitane-en-provence.industry: Retail sale of perfumery and beauty products in specialized stores
l-occitane-en-provence.description: L'Occitane en Provence is a French retailer of body, face, hair, home products, and fragrances based in Manosque, France. Founded in 1976, it was listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 2010 and was taken private by its controlling shareholder in 2024.

logitech.name: Logitech
logitech.description: Logitech International S.A. is a Swiss multinational manufacturer of computer peripherals and software headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland. The company operates globally with offices in Europe, Asia, Oceania, and the Americas. It is listed on the Nasdaq and is a component of the Swiss Market Index.

lundbeck.name: Lundbeck
lundbeck.description: Lundbeck is a Danish international pharmaceutical company that researches, develops, manufactures, markets, and sells pharmaceuticals worldwide. Its products focus on brain diseases such as depression, schizophrenia, Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, and migraine. The company is based in Denmark.

lotus-bakeries.name: Lotus Bakeries
lotus-bakeries.industry: Manufacture of rusks and biscuits; manufacture of preserved pastry goods and cakes
lotus-bakeries.description: Lotus Bakeries NV is a Belgian multinational snack food company founded in 1932 and based in Lembeke, East Flanders. It is best known for its speculoos biscuits branded as Biscoff and owns several other snack brands.

lazard.name: Lazard
lazard.description: Lazard Inc. is a multinational financial advisory and asset management firm headquartered in the United States. It provides investment banking, asset management, and other financial services primarily to institutional clients. The firm has principal offices in New York City, Paris, and London.

lectra.name: Lectra
lectra.description: Lectra is a technology company headquartered in Paris, France, operating in 59 countries with 59 subsidiaries. It specializes in CAD software and CAM cutting-room systems for industries using soft materials like leather and textiles, serving sectors such as fashion, automotive, and furniture.

libra-internet-bank.name: Libra Internet Bank
libra-internet-bank.description: Libra Internet Bank is a Romanian bank founded in 1996. It specializes in niche areas such as liberal professions, real estate, and agribusiness.

liveperson-inc.name: Liveperson Inc.
liveperson-inc.description: LivePerson is a global technology company that develops conversational commerce and artificial intelligence software.

luminex.name: Luminex
luminex.description: Luminex Corporation is a biotechnology company that develops, manufactures, and markets proprietary biological testing technologies with applications in life sciences.

leadtek-research.name: Leadtek Research
leadtek-research.description: Leadtek Research, Inc. is a Taiwanese company specializing in research and development focused on designing and manufacturing graphics cards. Founded in 1986, it operates in the computer hardware industry. The company is based in Taiwan.

lolc-holdings.name: LOLC Holdings
lolc-holdings.description: LOLC Holdings PLC is a Sri Lankan conglomerate listed on the Colombo Stock Exchange. It started as a non-banking financial company and has grown into one of the largest conglomerates in Sri Lanka, involved in many sectors and subsidiaries in several countries, mainly in the financial sector.

libsyn.name: Libsyn
libsyn.description: Liberated Syndication, Inc. (Libsyn) is an American podcasting company founded in 2004 in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. As of 2026, it is headquartered in Dallas, Texas.

live-nation-entertainment.name: Live Nation Entertainment
live-nation-entertainment.description: Live Nation Entertainment, Inc. is an American multinational entertainment company founded in 2010 after the merger of Live Nation and Ticketmaster. It operates both brands, promotes and manages ticket sales for live entertainment globally, owns venues and festivals, and manages music artists' careers.

luminar-technologies.name: Luminar Technologies
luminar-technologies.description: Luminar Technologies Inc. was a U.S.-based technology company specializing in vision-based lidar and machine perception technologies for self-driving cars. Its headquarters and main R&D facilities were in Orlando, Florida, with a major office in Palo Alto, California.

livewire.name: LiveWire
livewire.description: LiveWire is an American electric motorcycle manufacturer. It was launched as an EV division of Harley Davidson in 2021 and became the first publicly traded electric motorcycle company in the US after a 2022 SPAC merger.

lg-cns.name: LG CNS
lg-cns.description: LG CNS Co., Ltd. is a South Korean technology company providing services in artificial intelligence, robotics, cloud computing, smart factories, smart logistics, system integration, and IT outsourcing. It operates in the information technology industry.

lukfook-jewellery.name: Lukfook Jewellery
lukfook-jewellery.description: Luk Fook Holdings (International) Limited is a company engaged in sourcing, designing, wholesaling, trademark licensing, and retailing gold, platinum, and gem-set jewellery. It is listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange and has expanded into the mid to high-end watch market.

lixil.name: Lixil
lixil.description: Lixil Corporation is a Japanese manufacturer of building materials and housing equipment. The company is headquartered in Shinagawa, Tokyo.

lion-corporation.name: Lion Corporation
lion-corporation.description: Lion Corporation is a Japanese multinational company that manufactures detergent, soap, medications, oral hygiene products, and other toiletries. It also has a chemical engineering research division focused on developing new products. The company is based in Japan.

lolc-finance.name: LOLC Finance
lolc-finance.description: LOLC Finance PLC is a non-banking financial company based in Sri Lanka and a subsidiary of LOLC Holdings PLC. Established in 2001, it offers a wide range of financial services including savings, deposits, loans, and alternate financial solutions. It is one of the largest NBFIs in Sri Lanka.

lithium-americas.name: Lithium Americas
lithium-americas.description: Lithium Americas Corp. is a Canadian mining company currently developing the Thacker Pass Lithium Mine located in northern Nevada. It is engaged in the mining industry.

liveramp.name: LiveRamp
liveramp.description: LiveRamp Holdings, Inc. is an American SaaS company that provides a data connectivity platform. Its services include data onboarding, which involves transferring offline data online for marketing purposes. The company operates in the United States.

lotte-shopping.name: Lotte Shopping
lotte-shopping.description: Lotte Shopping Co., Ltd. is a multinational retailer headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. Founded in 1979, it operates various retail stores including department stores, outlet stores, hypermarkets, drug store chains, and e-commerce. The company also holds a majority stake in Lotte Cultureworks, engaging in the film industry.

lotte-chemical.name: Lotte Chemical
lotte-chemical.description: Lotte Chemical Corporation is a chemical company headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. It is one of the largest chemical companies in the world by revenue. The company manufactures synthetic resins and other chemical products used for various industrial materials.

lionsgate-studios.name: Lionsgate Studios
lionsgate-studios.description: Lionsgate Studios Corp. is a Canadian-American film and television production and distribution conglomerate domiciled in Vancouver, British Columbia, and primarily based in Santa Monica, California. It was formed on May 14, 2024, after Starz Entertainment spun off its film and television businesses and merged with Screaming Eagle Corporation.

lhv-pank.name: LHV Pank
lhv-pank.description: LHV Pank is an Estonian banking and financial services company headquartered in Tallinn. It serves private individuals, companies, and institutional investors and is the third largest bank in Estonia with multiple branch offices.

levi-strauss-co.name: Levi Strauss & Co.
levi-strauss-co.description: Levi Strauss & Co. is an American clothing company known worldwide for its Levi's denim jeans. Founded in 1853 by Levi Strauss in San Francisco, California, it is registered in Delaware and headquartered in Levi's Plaza in San Francisco.

lupin-ltd.name: Lupin Ltd.
lupin-ltd.description: Lupin Limited is an Indian multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Mumbai. It manufactures generic drugs covering various therapeutic areas and operates in international markets including the US, Japan, Europe, and Australia.

longyuan-power.name: Longyuan Power
longyuan-power.description: China Longyuan Power Group Limited, or Longyuan Power, is the largest wind power producer in China and Asia. It designs, develops, manages, and operates wind power plants and sells the electricity generated. As of June 2013, it had installed wind power plants with a total capacity of 10,661 MW.

lingbao-gold.name: Lingbao Gold
lingbao-gold.description: Lingbao Gold Group Company Ltd. is a state-owned gold mining enterprise headquartered in Lingbao, Henan Province, China. It operates in the gold mining industry and is owned by the state.

lowe-s.name: Lowe's
lowe-s.description: Lowe's Companies, Inc. is an American retail company specializing in home improvement. Headquartered in Mooresville, North Carolina, it operates a chain of retail stores across the United States. As of 2022, Lowe's operated 2,181 home improvement and hardware stores in North America.

luxoft.name: Luxoft
luxoft.description: Luxoft is a software development company headquartered in Zug, Switzerland, and a subsidiary of DXC Technology. It operates in 21 countries with over 17,000 employees and has large offices in the US, Poland, Germany, Bulgaria, India, Ukraine, Singapore, and Serbia.

lagardere-group.name: Lagardère Group
lagardere-group.description: Lagardère S.A. is an international group based in Paris, France, with operations in over 50 countries. Founded in 1992 by Jean-Luc Lagardère, it was originally named Matra, Hachette & Lagardère.

las-vegas-sands.name: Las Vegas Sands
las-vegas-sands.description: Las Vegas Sands Corp. is an American casino and resort company headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada. It was founded by Sheldon G. Adelson and partners, originating from the Sands Hotel and Casino on the Las Vegas Strip. The company redeveloped the Sands into The Venetian and opened The Palazzo resort.

luna-innovations.name: Luna Innovations
luna-innovations.description: Luna Innovations Incorporated is an American company based in Roanoke, Virginia. It develops and manufactures fiber-optics- and terahertz-based technology products for industries including aerospace, automotive, communications, and defense. Its products are used to test, measure, analyze, monitor, protect, and improve products and processes.

lawson.name: Lawson
lawson.description: Lawson, Inc. is a convenience store franchise chain in the Asia-Pacific region. Originally founded in the United States, it is now a Japanese company headquartered in Shinagawa, Tokyo. The company operates in the food retail sector.

lao-feng-xiang-company-limited.name: Lao Feng Xiang Company Limited
lao-feng-xiang-company-limited.description: Lao Feng Xiang is a Chinese jewelry brand with a history spanning 174 years of continuous operation. It is recognized as one of the oldest jewelry brands in China.

luxshare.name: Luxshare
luxshare.description: Luxshare Precision Industry Co. Ltd. is a Chinese electronic components manufacturer headquartered in Bao'an, Shenzhen, Guangdong. The company has been listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange since 2010.

lennar-corporation.name: Lennar Corporation
lennar-corporation.description: Lennar Corporation is an American home construction company based in Miami-Dade County, Florida. It operates in the construction industry within the United States.

layerone.name: LayerOne
layerone.description: LayerOne, Inc. was a U.S. private corporation providing carrier-neutral datacenters and interconnection services. It was acquired by Switch & Data in 2005. The company operated in the internet industry within the United States.

leg-immobilien.name: LEG Immobilien
leg-immobilien.description: LEG Immobilien SE is a German property company. As of 2025, it is a constituent of the MDAX trading index of German mid-cap companies. The company operates in the real estate industry.

leggett-platt.name: Leggett & Platt
leggett-platt.description: Leggett & Platt is an American diversified manufacturer based in Carthage, Missouri. The company designs and produces engineered components and products found in homes and automobiles. Founded in 1883, it operates 15 business units and 135 manufacturing facilities in 18 countries.

liaoning-chengda.name: Liaoning Chengda
liaoning-chengda.description: Liaoning Chengda Company Limited is a state-owned conglomerate based in Dalian, Liaoning, China. Its business activities include exports and imports, trading, chemical fertilizers, pharmaceuticals, property leasing, biological vaccines, and warehousing.

lincoln-national-corporation.name: Lincoln National Corporation
lincoln-national-corporation.description: Lincoln National Corporation is a Fortune 200 American holding company operating multiple insurance and investment management businesses through subsidiaries. Lincoln Financial Group is the marketing name for the company and its subsidiaries.

lendlease.name: Lendlease
lendlease.description: Lendlease Corporation Limited is an Australian multinational construction and real estate company headquartered in Barangaroo, Sydney, New South Wales. It operates in the real estate development industry.

lightspeed.name: Lightspeed
lightspeed.description: Lightspeed Commerce is a Canadian point-of-sale and e-commerce software provider based in Montreal, Quebec. Founded in 2005, it serves retail, restaurant, and hospitality businesses with offices worldwide.

louisiana-pacific.name: Louisiana-Pacific
louisiana-pacific.description: Louisiana-Pacific Corporation is an American building materials manufacturer founded in 1973. It was the first in the U.S. to commercially produce oriented strand board panels. Based in Nashville, Tennessee, it produces OSB and engineered wood products sold through distributors and retail home centers.

lufax.name: Lufax
lufax.description: Lufax, officially Shanghai Lujiazui International Financial Asset Exchange Co., Ltd., is an online Internet finance marketplace headquartered in Lujiazui, Shanghai, China. Founded in 2011, it is an associate of China Ping An Group.

lens-technology.name: Lens Technology
lens-technology.description: Lens Technology Co., Ltd. is a Chinese precision manufacturing company producing glass, ceramic, metal, and sapphire components for consumer electronics and automotive interaction systems. Its customers include multinational electronics and automotive manufacturers.

live-oak-bank.name: Live Oak Bank
live-oak-bank.description: Live Oak Bank is an American bank headquartered in Wilmington, North Carolina. It serves small business owners and was the largest SBA 7(a) lender by dollar volume in fiscal year 2025.

lt-group.name: LT Group
lt-group.description: LT Group, Inc. is a publicly listed holding company headquartered in Bonifacio Global City, Taguig, Philippines. It operates in the industrials and chemicals sector. The company is known as LTG in the Philippines.

lennox-international.name: Lennox International
lennox-international.description: Lennox International Inc. is an American company based in Richardson, Texas, providing climate control products for HVAC and refrigeration markets. Its largest production facilities are in Mexico, Iowa, and South Carolina.

lundin-energy.name: Lundin Energy
lundin-energy.description: Lundin Energy is an independent oil and gas exploration and production company based in Sweden. It was formed from Lundin Oil in 2001 and focuses on operations in Norway.

le-com.name: Le.com
le-com.description: Le.com, legally Leshi Internet Information and Technology Corp., Beijing, is a Chinese technology company headquartered in Chaoyang District, Beijing. It is one of the largest online video companies in China.

leyou.name: Leyou
leyou.description: Leyou Technologies Holdings Limited is a Chinese video game holding company based in Hong Kong. Founded in 2010, it transitioned from poultry to video games, acquiring several developers including Digital Extremes and Splash Damage. In December 2020, Leyou was acquired by Tencent.

longi-green-energy-technology.name: LONGi Green Energy Technology
longi-green-energy-technology.description: LONGi Green Energy Technology Co. Ltd., formerly Xi'an Longi Silicon Materials Corporation, is a Chinese photovoltaics company. It is a major manufacturer of solar modules and a developer of solar power projects.

lanka-graphite-limited.name: Lanka Graphite Limited
lanka-graphite-limited.description: Lanka Graphite Limited is an Australian company engaged in the mining of graphite in Sri Lanka.

loxley-pacific.name: Loxley Pacific
loxley-pacific.description: Loxley PCL is a Thai company involved in technology, IT, energy, and trading sectors. It operates across multiple industries within Thailand, providing diverse business services.

la-polar.name: La Polar
la-polar.description: La Polar was a retail company based in Chile. The summary provides limited information about its operations or history.

lojas-renner.name: Lojas Renner
lojas-renner.description: Lojas Renner S.A. is a leading fashion and lifestyle retailer in Brazil, founded in 1922. Originally part of the AJ Renner Group, it separated from the group in 1965 and evolved its store format to its current model. The company is a significant player in Brazil's retail sector.

lamar-advertising-company.name: Lamar Advertising Company
lamar-advertising-company.description: Lamar Advertising Company is an American outdoor advertising firm operating billboards, logo signs, and transit displays across the United States and Canada. Founded in 1902 and headquartered in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, it became a real estate investment trust in 2014.

lamb-weston.name: Lamb Weston
lamb-weston.description: Lamb Weston Holdings, Inc. is an American food processing company headquartered in Eagle, Idaho. It is one of the world's largest producers and processors of frozen french fries, waffle fries, and other frozen potato products.

landi-renzo.name: Landi Renzo
landi-renzo.description: Landi Renzo S.p.A is a multinational company based in Cavriago, Italy. It produces pressure management components for natural gas and hydrogen and operates in sustainable mobility and infrastructure sectors. The company serves OEMs and the aftermarket in mobility and provides solutions and project management for global energy companies in infrastructure.

level-3-communications.name: Level 3 Communications
level-3-communications.description: Level 3 Communications, Inc. was an American multinational telecommunications and internet service provider headquartered in Broomfield, Colorado. It became part of CenturyLink, with its President and CEO Jeff Storey becoming CEO of CenturyLink in a planned succession.

light-s-a.name: Light S.A.
light-s-a.description: Light S.A. is a private sector public utility company based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. Founded in 1904 in Toronto, Canada, it was authorized to operate in Brazil in 1905. The company operates in the renewables and utilities sector.

loral-space-communications.name: Loral Space & Communications
loral-space-communications.description: Loral Space & Communications Inc. is a satellite communications company based in Delaware, United States. It was formed in 1996 from the remnants of Loral Corporation after divesting its defense electronics and system integration businesses. The company is led by Michael B. Targoff.

lemonade.name: Lemonade
lemonade.description: Lemonade, Inc. is an American insurance company based in New York City. It offers various insurance products in the US and Europe, utilizing artificial intelligence and chatbots to sell policies and handle claims.

lsr-group.name: LSR Group
lsr-group.description: LSR Group is a Russian company engaged in real estate development, construction, and building materials. Its headquarters are in Saint Petersburg. The company has numerous subsidiaries and is a leader in its sector within Russia.

luzhou-laojiao.name: Luzhou Laojiao
luzhou-laojiao.description: Luzhou Laojiao Co. Ltd. is a Chinese company based in Luzhou, Sichuan, specializing in the production and distribution of baijiu. It is known for the Nongxiang style of baijiu, originally named after the distillery. It ranks as the fourth most valuable spirits brand globally.

leadway-technology-investment-group-limi.name: Leadway Technology Investment Group Limited
leadway-technology-investment-group-limi.description: Leadway Technology Investments Holdings Limited is a Cayman Islands-incorporated offshore holding company. Its subsidiary, Advanced Card Systems Limited, was incorporated in British Hong Kong in 1995, and was acquired by HNA Group in 2017 as part of a reverse IPO.

lg-display.name: LG Display
lg-display.description: LG Display Co., Ltd. is a major manufacturer and supplier of TFT-LCD panels, OLEDs, and flexible displays. Headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, it operates nine fabrication and seven assembly facilities across South Korea, China, Poland, and Mexico.

land-and-houses.name: Land and Houses
land-and-houses.description: Land and Houses Public Company Limited is a large real estate company based in Thailand. Founded in 1983 by Ms Piangjai Harnpanij and her son, Mr Anant Asavabhokhin, it was listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand in 1991. The largest shareholder group is Mr Anant Asavabhokin and his family.

leidos.name: Leidos
leidos.description: Leidos Holdings, Inc. is an American defense, aviation, IT, and biomedical research company headquartered in Reston, Virginia. It provides scientific, engineering, systems integration, and technical services, and was formed by merging SAIC with Lockheed Martin's IT sector in 2016. Leidos contracts extensively with U.S. government agencies including the Department of Defense and Homeland Security.

lear-corporation.name: Lear Corporation
lear-corporation.description: Lear Corporation is an American manufacturer of automotive seating and electrical systems. It is recognized as a Fortune 500 company.

lonmin.name: Lonmin
lonmin.description: Lonmin plc, formerly Lonrho plc, was a British producer of platinum group metals operating in the Bushveld Complex of South Africa. It was listed on the London Stock Exchange with its registered office in London and operational headquarters in Johannesburg.

land-securities.name: Land Securities
land-securities.description: Land Securities Group plc, trading as Landsec, is the largest commercial property development and investment company in the United Kingdom. It became a real estate investment trust in January 2007 and is headquartered in London. The company is traded on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index.

lumen-technologies.name: Lumen Technologies
lumen-technologies.description: Lumen Technologies, Inc. is an American telecommunications company headquartered in Monroe, Louisiana. It provides network, security, cloud, voice, and other managed communications services through fiber optic and copper networks, data centers, and cloud computing services. The company has been included in the S&P 600 index since March 2023.

lotte-corporation.name: Lotte Corporation
lotte-corporation.description: Lotte Corporation is a South Korean multinational conglomerate and the fifth-largest chaebol in South Korea. Founded in 1948 by Shin Kyuk-ho in Tokyo, it expanded to South Korea with the establishment of Lotte Confectionery in Seoul in 1967.

liugong.name: LiuGong
liugong.description: LiuGong, officially Guangxi LiuGong Machinery Co., Ltd., is a Chinese multinational construction machinery manufacturer headquartered in Liuzhou, China. It is the world's 10th-largest construction equipment manufacturer by market share and the largest manufacturer of wheel loaders globally.

leaf-group.name: Leaf Group
leaf-group.description: Leaf Group, formerly Demand Media Inc., was an American content company operating online brands such as eHow and livestrong.com. It provided social media platforms and content distribution tools and was known as a content farm. The company was created in 2006 by Shawn Colo and Richard Rosenblatt.

lakefront-biotherapeutics.name: Lakefront Biotherapeutics
lakefront-biotherapeutics.description: Lakefront Biotherapeutics is a Belgian pharmaceutical research company founded in 1999. Its headquarters are in Mechelen, with additional locations in Leiden, Romainville, Basel, Milan, Madrid, Boston, and Zagreb.

luckin-coffee.name: Luckin Coffee
luckin-coffee.description: Luckin Coffee Inc. is a Chinese coffee company and coffeehouse chain founded in Beijing in 2017. It operates shops, stores, and kiosks offering coffee, tea, and food, generally at lower prices than competitors. The company is headquartered in Xiamen, Fujian, and by 2019, its stores outnumbered Starbucks locations in China.

latitude-financial-services.name: Latitude Financial Services
latitude-financial-services.description: Latitude Financial Services is an Australian financial services company headquartered in Melbourne, also operating in New Zealand as Gem Finance. It specializes in consumer finance products including personal loans, credit cards, and car loans. It is the largest non-bank lender of consumer credit in Australia.

loopup.name: LoopUp
loopup.description: LoopUp is a global provider of cloud-based business telephony services. Its main product is a managed cloud telephony service for Microsoft Teams, offered as an alternative to multiple regional carriers. LoopUp delivers Teams calling through various Microsoft connectivity programs and carrier arrangements.

lg-uplus.name: LG Uplus
lg-uplus.description: LG Uplus Corp. is a South Korean mobile network operator owned by LG Corporation. Formerly known as LG Telecom, it is the second-largest wireless carrier in South Korea as of 2023.

la-z-boy.name: La-Z-Boy
la-z-boy.description: La-Z-Boy Inc. is an American furniture manufacturer based in Monroe, Michigan. It produces home furniture including recliners, sofas, and sleeper sofas, employing over 11,000 people.

lebedyansky.name: Lebedyansky
lebedyansky.description: Lebedyansky is a Russian multinational company that manufactures fruit juice, baby food, vegetable juice, and soft drinks. It is owned by PepsiCo and is the largest fruit juice manufacturer in Eastern Europe. The company has two major production centers in Lipetsk Oblast.

lgi-homes.name: LGI Homes
lgi-homes.description: LGI Homes is a Texas-based builder of new construction homes and housing developments, primarily in the southwestern United States. It is recognized as one of the largest home builders in the country. The company went public in 2013 and has shown growth in home sales and revenue.

lig-defense-aerospace.name: LIG Defense&Aerospace
lig-defense-aerospace.description: LIG Defense & Aerospace, formerly LG Innotek and LIG Nex1, is a South Korean aerospace and arms manufacturer established in 1976 as Goldstar Precision. It was previously owned by LIG Holdings and the LIG Group. In 2013, a consortium led by STIC Investments acquired a 49% stake in the company.

labcorp.name: LabCorp
labcorp.description: Labcorp Holdings Inc., operating as Labcorp, is headquartered in Burlington, North Carolina. It provides laboratory services for diagnosis and healthcare decisions and operates one of the largest clinical laboratory networks globally, with operations in over 100 countries, primarily in the U.S.

lancashire-holdings.name: Lancashire Holdings
lancashire-holdings.description: Lancashire Holdings Limited is a Bermuda-incorporated insurance company with subsidiaries in Bermuda, London, the US, and Australia. It operates two syndicates at Lloyd’s of London and is listed on the London Stock Exchange as part of the FTSE 250 Index.

latam-airlines.name: LATAM Airlines
latam-airlines.description: LATAM Airlines is a Chilean multinational airline headquartered in Santiago. It is the largest airline holding company in Latin America with subsidiaries in Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador, Paraguay, and Peru.

ltm-limited.name: LTM Limited
ltm-limited.description: LTM Limited is an Indian multinational information technology services and consulting company based in Mumbai. It is a subsidiary of Larsen & Toubro and was incorporated in 1996, employing over 87,950 people.

lechters-housewares.name: Lechters Housewares
lechters-housewares.description: Lechters Housewares was a U.S.-based national chain of kitchen-supply stores headquartered in Harrison, New Jersey. Many stores were located in malls, and the company owned the Costless Home Store and Famous Brands Housewares Outlet chains. Its store-brand products were sold under the name Cooks Club.

loandepot.name: LoanDepot
loandepot.description: LoanDepot is a nonbank holding company based in Irvine, California. It sells mortgage and non-mortgage lending products. The company is sometimes stylized as loanDepot.

lee-enterprises.name: Lee Enterprises
lee-enterprises.description: Lee Enterprises, Inc. is an American media company based in Davenport, Iowa. It publishes 72 daily newspapers in 25 states and more than 350 weekly, classified, and specialty publications. The company was founded in 1890 by Alfred Wilson Lee.

legalzoom.name: LegalZoom
legalzoom.description: LegalZoom.com, Inc. is an American online legal technology and services company launched in 2001. It provides online legal services through an independent network of attorneys and its own law firm. Services include wills, business compliance, copyright registrations, and trademark applications.

legend-holdings.name: Legend Holdings
legend-holdings.description: Legend Holdings Corporation is a Chinese investment holding company with interests in finance, real estate, and information technology. It is the controlling shareholder of Lenovo Group. The company was formed by the Chinese Academy of Sciences and was originally named Legend Computer.

lorena.name: Lorena
lorena.description: PT Eka Sari Lorena Transport Tbk is a publicly traded bus company in Indonesia. It provides inter-city transport buses with long distance routes. The company operates in the transport and logistics sector.

lexicon-pharmaceuticals.name: Lexicon Pharmaceuticals
lexicon-pharmaceuticals.description: Lexicon Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company founded in 1995 in The Woodlands, Texas. It develops treatments for human diseases using mouse gene knockout technology and has identified over 100 potential therapeutic targets. The company pursues drug targets in oncology, gastroenterology, immunology, metabolism, and ophthalmology.

lexington-state-bank.name: Lexington State Bank
lexington-state-bank.description: Lexington State Bank was a banking company based in Lexington, North Carolina, with 29 branches in the Piedmont Triad region. Its holding company was LSB Bancshares, Inc. In 2007, it merged with FNB Southeast to form NewBridge Bank.

lifelock.name: LifeLock
lifelock.description: LifeLock is identity theft prevention software originally sold by the LifeLock company and now by Gen. Marketed as NortonLifeLock after 2017, it is bundled with Norton 360 products and provides monitoring, alerts, and financial coverage for identity theft and scams.

life-time.name: Life Time
life-time.description: Life Time, Inc. operates a chain of athletic country clubs in the United States and Canada.

lifeboat-distribution.name: Lifeboat Distribution
lifeboat-distribution.description: Lifeboat Distribution is an international value-added distributor serving vendors specializing in virtualization, cloud computing, security, application and network infrastructure, business continuity, database management, and other technical products.

lightyear-capital.name: Lightyear Capital
lightyear-capital.description: Lightyear Capital is a private equity firm based in New York City, founded in 2000 by Donald Marron. It invests primarily in financial services, financial technology, healthcare, and business-services companies. Mark Vassallo has led the firm since 2019.

lincoln-electric.name: Lincoln Electric
lincoln-electric.description: Lincoln Electric Holdings, Inc. is an American multinational manufacturer of welding products and equipment headquartered in Euclid, Ohio. It operates globally with manufacturing locations and alliances in multiple countries and is a member of the Fortune 1000.

lindsay-manufacturing.name: Lindsay Manufacturing
lindsay-manufacturing.description: Lindsay Corporation, formerly Lindsay Manufacturing Co., is a manufacturer of Zimmatic brand center pivot irrigation systems based in Omaha, Nebraska. It also produces farm and construction machinery, as well as road and railroad infrastructure equipment.

lion-electric-company.name: Lion Electric Company
lion-electric-company.description: LION is a Canadian electric vehicle manufacturer headquartered in Saint-Jérôme, Quebec. Founded in 2011 as Lion Bus, it is known for being the first to mass produce fully electric yellow school buses.

lippo-cikarang.name: Lippo Cikarang
lippo-cikarang.description: Lippo Cikarang is an independent township developed by PT Lippo Cikarang Tbk, a subsidiary of Lippo Group, located in Cikarang, West Java, Indonesia. The township covers about 3000 hectares and includes over 14,000 houses and nearly 1,000 manufacturing companies.

lithia-motors.name: Lithia Motors
lithia-motors.description: Lithia Motors, Inc. is an American automotive dealership group headquartered in Medford, Oregon. It operates 459 dealership locations across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Lithia is the largest automotive retailer in the United States by revenue as of 2025.

littelfuse.name: Littelfuse
littelfuse.description: Littelfuse, Inc. is an American electronics manufacturing company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. It produces circuit protection products, switches, automotive sensors, and microprocessors through its subsidiary Zilog. Littelfuse developed the first blade-type automotive fuse called AutoFuse.

loma-negra.name: Loma Negra
loma-negra.description: Loma Negra Compañía Industrial Argentina S.A. is an Argentine manufacturer and the country's leading maker of cement, concrete, and lime. The company was established by Alfredo Fortabat, who also founded its sports club. After his passing, his wife Amalia Lacroze took over the business.

lookers.name: Lookers
lookers.description: Lookers is a British car dealership chain operating in the United Kingdom and Ireland. It represents multiple automotive brands and is based in Altrincham. The company was acquired by Global Auto Holdings in 2023.

lotte-chilsung.name: Lotte Chilsung
lotte-chilsung.description: Lotte Chilsung Beverage Co., Ltd. is a South Korean drink manufacturer affiliated with Lotte Corporation. The company's name means "Big Dipper" and its logo features seven stars aligned in a row. It operates in the agriculture and food industry.

luby-s.name: Luby's
luby-s.description: Luby’s Restaurant Corporation is a chain of cafeteria-style restaurants based in Texas, United States. It previously owned other restaurant chains including Fuddruckers, Koo Koo Roo, and Cheeseburger in Paradise. The company operates in the system catering industry.

lumber-liquidators.name: Lumber Liquidators
lumber-liquidators.description: Lumber Liquidators is an American retailer specializing in hard-surface flooring products such as hardwood, laminate, vinyl plank, tile, bamboo, and cork. The company also sells flooring tools and accessories. It filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in August 2024 but avoided liquidation after being acquired by its original founder.

lumos.name: Lumos
lumos.description: Lumos is a telecommunications company based in Waynesboro, Virginia, and High Point, North Carolina, United States. It offers residential and business fiber-optic internet services, VOIP telephone, web hosting, and digital television. The company merged with North State Communications effective August 15, 2022.

luoyang-glass.name: Luoyang Glass
luoyang-glass.description: Luoyang Glass Company Limited is a state-owned enterprise located in Luoyang, Henan, China. It produces and sells float sheet and flat glass and reprocesses automobile glass. The company operates in the glass industry.

luxempart.name: Luxempart
luxempart.description: Luxempart is a Luxembourg investment company listed on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange. It specializes in direct investments primarily in Luxembourg, Belgium, France, and Germany, as well as investments in private equity funds. Luxempart is included in the LuxX Index, the benchmark index of the Luxembourg Stock Exchange.

lynas.name: Lynas
lynas.description: Lynas Rare Earths, Ltd. is an Australian rare-earths mining company headquartered in Perth, Western Australia. It operates a mining and concentration plant at Mount Weld in Western Australia and the Lynas Advanced Materials Plant in Kuantan, Malaysia. The company was founded in the 1990s.

lonza-group.name: Lonza Group
lonza-group.description: Lonza Group AG is a Swiss multinational manufacturing company headquartered in Basel. It serves the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and nutrition sectors with product development services and custom manufacturing of biopharmaceuticals and detection systems.

lifevantage.name: LifeVantage
lifevantage.description: LifeVantage Corporation is a Utah-based multi-level marketing company that sells Protandim, a patented herbal dietary supplement. The product is marketed with unsupported claims about treating medical conditions. In 2017, the company received a warning letter from the FDA regarding illegal advertising claims on its websites.

light-wonder.name: Light & Wonder
light-wonder.description: Light & Wonder, Inc., formerly Scientific Games Corporation, is an American company providing gambling products and services. It is headquartered in Enterprise, Nevada, with a Las Vegas mailing address.

lotte-chemical-titan.name: Lotte Chemical Titan
lotte-chemical-titan.description: Lotte Chemical Titan Holding Sdn Bhd is a Malaysian company operating polypropylene, polyethylene, ethylene cracker, and aromatic plants. It produces various types of polyethylene for applications ranging from household goods to automotive products and is based in Pasir Gudang, Malaysia.

lattice-semiconductor.name: Lattice Semiconductor
lattice-semiconductor.description: Lattice Semiconductor Corporation is an American semiconductor company specializing in low-power field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs). Headquartered in Hillsboro, Oregon, it has operations worldwide and was founded in 1983. The company went public in 1989 and is traded on Nasdaq.

lotte-himart.name: Lotte Himart
lotte-himart.description: Lotte Hi-Mart is a South Korean retailer of electronic goods headquartered in Seoul. It was originally a unit of bankrupt Daewoo Electronics before being spun off in 1999. The company was taken over by Lotte Corporation in 2012.

life-storage.name: Life Storage
life-storage.description: Life Storage, Inc. was a real estate investment trust headquartered in Williamsville, New York, investing in self storage units. The company was acquired by Extra Space Storage in July 2023.

loews-corporation.name: Loews Corporation
loews-corporation.description: Loews Corporation is an American conglomerate headquartered in New York City. Its major holdings include CNA Financial Corporation, Boardwalk Pipelines, Loews Hotels, and Altium Packaging.

link-reit.name: Link REIT
link-reit.description: Link Real Estate Investment Trust is a wholly-owned private real estate investment trust managed by Link Asset Management Limited. It is the first real estate investment trust in Hong Kong and the largest in Asia by market capitalization.

lands-end.name: Lands' End
lands-end.description: Lands' End, Inc. is an American retailer of clothing, baggage, and furniture headquartered in Dodgeville, Wisconsin. Founded in 1963 as a mail-order yachting supply company, it operates 26 domestic stores as of February 2024.

ly-corporation.name: LY Corporation
ly-corporation.description: LY Corporation, trading as LYC, is a Japanese internet company majority-owned by A Holdings, a joint venture between SoftBank Group and Naver Corporation. It was formed in 2023 through the merger of Z Holdings and four subsidiaries including Line Corporation and Yahoo! Japan.

liberty-global.name: Liberty Global
liberty-global.description: Liberty Global Ltd. is a multinational telecommunications company domiciled in Bermuda with headquarters in London, Amsterdam, and Denver. It was formed in 2005 by merging Liberty Media's international arm and UnitedGlobalCom.

logista.name: Logista
logista.description: Logista is a Spanish company that operates as a distributor of products and services to proximity retailers in Southern Europe. Its distribution includes tobacco, convenience, pharmaceutical products, books, periodicals, and e-transactions. The company also provides various transport services including long distance, temperature-controlled, and express courier services.

lery.name: Lerøy
lery.description: Lerøy Seafood Group ASA is a seafood production and distribution company based in Bergen, Norway. It operates in the seafood industry.

legg-mason.name: Legg Mason
legg-mason.description: Legg Mason, Inc. was an American investment management and asset management firm headquartered in Baltimore. Founded in 1899, it was acquired by Franklin Templeton Investments in July 2020. The company managed a diverse portfolio including equity, fixed income, alternative, and liquidity assets.

lassonde-industries.name: Lassonde Industries
lassonde-industries.description: Lassonde Industries Inc. is a Canadian agri-food company based in Rougemont, Montérégie. It operates throughout North America, focusing on agriculture and food products.

legit-ng.name: Legit.ng
legit-ng.description: Legit.ng, also known as Legit News, is a Nigerian digital media and news platform operated by Naij.com Media Limited. It is part of Legit (formerly GMEM) and provides news content primarily in Nigeria.

latecoere.name: Latécoère
latecoere.description: Groupe Latécoère is an aircraft company based in Toulouse, France. Founded in 1917 by Pierre-Georges Latécoère, it became known for its range of seaplanes, including the six-engined Latécoère 631.

ls-electiric.name: LS Electiric
ls-electiric.description: LS Electric Co., Ltd., formerly LS Industrial Systems, is an electric power equipment and industrial automation company headquartered in Anyang, South Korea. It is a key affiliate of the LS Group, alongside LS Cable & System and LS MnM.

laurentian-bank-of-canada.name: Laurentian Bank of Canada
laurentian-bank-of-canada.description: The Laurentian Bank of Canada is a Schedule 1 bank that became a subsidiary of Fairstone Bank of Canada on November 1, 2026. It primarily serves large business clients after selling other lines of business to National Bank of Canada.

lucky-cement.name: Lucky Cement
lucky-cement.description: Lucky Cement Limited is a Pakistani conglomerate headquartered in Karachi. Named after Lakki Marwat where its first plant was commissioned in 1993, it is one of Pakistan's largest cement producers. The company is listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange.

liberty-media.name: Liberty Media
liberty-media.description: Liberty Media Corporation is an American mass media company founded in 1991 by John C. Malone. It is known for diversified media and entertainment investments and the use of tracking stocks. As of 2026, its primary assets include three global motorsport businesses: Formula One, MotoGP, and World Superbikes.

lundin-mining.name: Lundin Mining
lundin-mining.description: Lundin Mining Corporation is a Canadian mining company headquartered in Vancouver. It owns and operates mines producing base metals like gold, silver, copper, and nickel, with major properties in Chile, Brazil, and the United States.

lsi-corporation.name: LSI Corporation
lsi-corporation.description: LSI Logic Corporation was an American company based in Santa Clara, California. It designed and sold semiconductors and software that accelerated storage and networking in data centers, mobile networks, and client computing. The company specialized in ASIC and EDA technologies.

lg-innotek.name: LG Innotek
lg-innotek.description: LG Innotek Co., Ltd. is a South Korean electronic component manufacturer headquartered in Seoul. It is an affiliate of LG Group and produces core components for mobile devices, automotive displays, semiconductors, and smart products. A significant portion of its revenue comes from selling camera modules for the iPhone.

ladbrokes.name: Ladbrokes
ladbrokes.description: Ladbrokes is a British gambling company established in 1886. Its product offerings include sports betting, online casino, online poker, and online bingo. The company operates primarily in the United Kingdom.

linamar.name: Linamar
linamar.description: Linamar Corporation is a Canadian manufacturing company serving the mobility, access, agriculture, and MedTech industries. It operates through three segments: Industrial, Mobility, and eLIN.

lotte-tour-development.name: Lotte Tour Development
lotte-tour-development.description: Lotte Tour Development is a South Korean tourism corporation headquartered in Seoul. Founded in 1971, it operates as a travel agency, travel information provider, and casino proprietor, owning the Jeju Dream Tower casino, the tallest building on Jeju Island.

law-debenture.name: Law Debenture
law-debenture.description: The Law Debenture Corporation plc is a British investment trust providing diversified investments and fiduciary services. It appoints agents, directors, and trustees for pension funds, trusts, and companies. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

le-chateau.name: Le Château
le-chateau.description: Le Château Inc. is a Canadian fashion company founded in 1959 in Montreal, Quebec. It designs, imports, and retails women's and men's apparel, accessories, and footwear. The company operates within Suzy Shier stores following its bankruptcy, having previously operated 123 retail stores in Canada and several in the UAE and Saudi Arabia.

leisure-and-gaming.name: Leisure and Gaming
leisure-and-gaming.description: Leisure and Gaming plc was a holding company based in London, United Kingdom. It was listed on the London Stock Exchange and had major assets in the global interactive betting and gaming industry. Its interests included software development and marketing.

leon-s.name: Leon's
leon-s.description: Leon's Furniture Ltd. is a Canadian furniture retailer founded in 1909 in Welland, Ontario. The company operates stores across all Canadian provinces. The Leon family holds the controlling interest, while some shares are publicly traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange.

loghman-pharmaceuticals.name: Loghman Pharmaceuticals
loghman-pharmaceuticals.description: Loghman Pharmaceutical & Hygienic Co. is an Iranian pharmaceuticals company engaged in the discovery, development, manufacture, and marketing of drugs in Iran.

lodha-group.name: Lodha Group
lodha-group.description: Lodha Group, headquartered in Mumbai, India, is a multinational real estate and construction company founded in 1980 by Mangal Prabhat Lodha. It develops residential and commercial properties in multiple cities including Mumbai, Thane, Hyderabad, Pune, Bengaluru, and London.

leap-wireless.name: Leap Wireless
leap-wireless.description: Leap Wireless International, Inc. was a telecommunications operator headquartered in San Diego, California. It provided wireless services through its subsidiary Cricket Communications and was the fifth largest in the U.S. Leap Wireless and Cricket Wireless are now subsidiaries of AT&T.

lesotho-airways.name: Lesotho Airways
lesotho-airways.description: Lesotho Airways, formerly Air Lesotho, was the national airline of Lesotho based at Mejametalana Airport in Maseru. It operated international and domestic passenger services until 1997. The airline suspended international flights in 1996 and was acquired by Rossair Contracts Private Ltd in 1997.

libyan-foreign-bank.name: Libyan Foreign Bank
libyan-foreign-bank.description: Libyan Foreign Bank (LFB) is a Libyan bank established in 1972 in Tripoli. It was Libya's first offshore banking institution licensed to operate internationally. The Central Bank of Libya owns 100% of LFB, and its head office is located in Tripoli.

libyana.name: Libyana
libyana.description: Libyana Mobile Phone is a Libyan mobile phone company established in 2004. It is state-owned via LPTIC and is one of the two major mobile phone operators in Libya. The company offers 4G+ and VoLTE coverage and is testing 5G technology.

libyan-arab-air-cargo.name: Libyan Arab Air Cargo
libyan-arab-air-cargo.description: Libyan Air Cargo was a cargo airline based in Tripoli, Libya, serving as the cargo division of Libyan Airlines. It operated all-cargo services with its main base at Tripoli International Airport, serving destinations across Africa, Europe, and Asia.

libyan-iron-and-steel-company.name: Libyan Iron and Steel Company
libyan-iron-and-steel-company.description: The Libyan Iron and Steel Company (Lisco) is one of the largest iron and steelmaking companies in North Africa. Based in Misrata, it is government-owned and was founded in 1979. In 2004, it was ranked third among the largest Arab iron and steel companies.

libyan-airlines.name: Libyan Airlines
libyan-airlines.description: Libyan Airlines is the flag carrier of Libya, based in Tripoli. It operates scheduled passenger and cargo services within Libya and to Europe, North Africa, and the Middle East, with Tripoli International Airport as its main base and Benina International Airport as a secondary base. The company is wholly owned by the government of Libya.

libyan-wings.name: Libyan Wings
libyan-wings.description: Libyan Wings Airlines Co JSC, or Libyan Wings, is an airline headquartered in ben ashour, Tripoli, Libya. It started operations in September 2015 and operates four Airbus A319s to destinations in Libya, Tunisia, and Turkey.

lam-mozambique-airlines.name: LAM Mozambique Airlines
lam-mozambique-airlines.description: LAM Mozambique Airlines, also known as Linhas Aéreas de Moçambique, is the flag carrier airline of Mozambique. Established in 1936 and based in Maputo, it operates scheduled services in Southern Africa with its hub at Maputo International Airport. The airline is a member of the International Air Transport Association and the African Airlines Association since 1976.

lagos-state-ministry-of-science-and-tech.name: Lagos State Ministry of Science and Technology
lagos-state-ministry-of-science-and-tech.legal_name: Lagos State Ministry of Science and Technology
lagos-state-ministry-of-science-and-tech.description: The Lagos State Ministry of Science and Technology is a government ministry in Lagos State, Nigeria. It is responsible for planning, devising, and implementing state policies related to science and technology. The ministry plays a key role in shaping the technological development of Lagos State.

lagos-state-ministry-of-commerce-and-ind.name: Lagos State Ministry of Commerce and Industry
lagos-state-ministry-of-commerce-and-ind.legal_name: Lagos State Ministry of Commerce and Industry
lagos-state-ministry-of-commerce-and-ind.description: The Lagos State Ministry of Commerce Cooperatives, Trade and Investment is a government ministry in Lagos State, Nigeria. It is responsible for planning, devising, and implementing policies on commerce, cooperatives, trade, and investment. The ministry aims to ensure business prosperity and consumer satisfaction in Lagos State.

lagos-state-ministry-of-agriculture-and-.name: Lagos State Ministry of Agriculture and Cooperatives
lagos-state-ministry-of-agriculture-and-.legal_name: Lagos State Ministry of Agriculture and Cooperatives
lagos-state-ministry-of-agriculture-and-.description: The Lagos State Ministry of Agriculture and Cooperatives is a government ministry in Lagos State, Nigeria. It is charged with planning, devising, and implementing state policies on agriculture and cooperatives. The ministry focuses on agricultural development within Lagos State.

lagos-television.name: Lagos Television
lagos-television.description: Lagos Television is a state-owned television station located in Ikeja, Lagos, Nigeria. Established in October 1980, it was the first Nigerian television station to operate on both VHF and UHF frequencies. It was also the first state-owned TV station available on cable satellite platforms like DSTV and GoTV.

lagos-state-ministry-of-works-and-infras.name: Lagos State Ministry of Works and Infrastructure
lagos-state-ministry-of-works-and-infras.legal_name: Lagos State Ministry of Works and Infrastructure
lagos-state-ministry-of-works-and-infras.description: The Lagos State Ministry of Works and Infrastructure was established in 1967 and is considered a key driver of growth and development in Lagos State, Nigeria.

lagos-state-waste-management-authority.name: Lagos State Waste Management Authority
lagos-state-waste-management-authority.description: The Lagos Waste Management Authority (LAWMA) is a government parastatal responsible for waste collection, transportation, and disposal in Lagos State. Its mission is to improve environmental health and sanitation conditions in Lagos.

lagos-state-ministry-of-finance.name: Lagos State Ministry of Finance
lagos-state-ministry-of-finance.description: The Lagos State Ministry of Finance is a government ministry responsible for planning and implementing financial policies for Lagos State, Nigeria. It manages the state's public finance operations.

lekoil.name: Lekoil
lekoil.description: LEKOIL is a Cayman incorporated company focused on African oil exploration and production, with interests in Nigeria and offshore Namibia. Founded in 2010, it was listed on the Alternative Investment Market of the London Stock Exchange in 2013.

lagos-state-ministry-of-environment.name: Lagos State Ministry of Environment
lagos-state-ministry-of-environment.description: The Lagos State Ministry of Environment is a state government ministry responsible for planning, devising, and implementing environmental management policies in Lagos State, Nigeria.

lagos-state-ministry-of-women-affairs-an.name: Lagos State Ministry of Women Affairs and Poverty Alleviation
lagos-state-ministry-of-women-affairs-an.legal_name: Lagos State Ministry of Women Affairs and Poverty Alleviation
lagos-state-ministry-of-women-affairs-an.description: The Lagos State Ministry of Women's Affairs and Poverty Alleviation was established in 1999 to address issues related to women's affairs and poverty reduction in Lagos State, Nigeria.

lagos-state-ministry-of-home-affairs-and.name: Lagos State Ministry of Home Affairs and Culture
lagos-state-ministry-of-home-affairs-and.legal_name: Lagos State Ministry of Home Affairs and Culture
lagos-state-ministry-of-home-affairs-and.description: The Lagos State Ministry of Home Affairs and Culture is a government ministry responsible for planning and implementing state policies on Home Affairs and Culture in Lagos State, Nigeria.

la-poste-senegal.name: La Poste Sénégal
la-poste-senegal.description: La Poste Sénégal is a postal service company in Senegal. It is a member of the Universal Postal Union. The company provides mail services in Senegal.

leti-arts.name: Leti Arts
leti-arts.description: Leti Arts is a Ghanaian video game company headquartered in Accra. It was founded by Eyram Tawia, who is a member of the Harambe Entrepreneur Alliance.

linx-software-house.name: Linx (software house)
linx-software-house.description: Linx S.A. is a Brazilian management software company and the largest software house in retail management systems in Latin America. It holds a significant market share in Brazil's retail management software sector.

lacta.name: Lacta
lacta.description: Lacta is a Brazilian chocolate and confectionery maker founded in São Paulo in 1912. It was purchased by Philip Morris in 1996 and integrated into its Kraft Foods Division.

lojas-riachuelo.name: Lojas Riachuelo
lojas-riachuelo.description: Lojas Riachuelo is a Brazilian department store company founded in 1947 in Natal, Brazil. The company operates 302 stores across the country. It is a notable retail chain in Brazil.

level-up-games.name: Level Up! Games
level-up-games.description: Level Up! Games is a game publishing studio originally from the Philippines, owned by Asiasoft since 2014. It operates in the Philippines and Latin America, focusing on the video game industry.

latam-brasil.name: LATAM Brasil
latam-brasil.description: LATAM Airlines Brasil, formerly TAM Linhas Aéreas, is the Brazilian brand of the Chilean LATAM Airlines Group. It operates international and domestic flights from hubs in Brasília, Fortaleza, and São Paulo. It is the largest domestic and international airline in Brazil by market share.

latam-cargo-brasil.name: LATAM Cargo Brasil
latam-cargo-brasil.description: LATAM Cargo Brasil is a cargo airline based in Campinas, Brazil. It operates scheduled services within Latin America and between Brazil and the United States, as well as charter services. Its main base is Viracopos International Airport.

lider.name: Lider
lider.description: Líder is a Chilean hypermarket chain originally owned by Distribución y Servicio (DyS). In 2009, it was sold to the American corporation Walmart. Líder operates in the retail sector in Chile.

latam-cargo-chile.name: LATAM Cargo Chile
latam-cargo-chile.description: LATAM Cargo Chile is a cargo airline based in Santiago, Chile, and a freight subsidiary of the LATAM Airlines Group. It operates cargo flights within South America, Europe, and North America from hubs including Miami International Airport and Arturo Merino Benítez International Airport.

latin-american-wings.name: Latin American Wings
latin-american-wings.description: Latin American Wings (LAW) was a short-lived scheduled charter airline based at Arturo Merino Benítez International Airport in Santiago, Chile. It operated flights to six destinations using Boeing 737-300 aircraft before suspending operations.

ledesma-s-a-a-i.name: Ledesma S.A.A.I.
ledesma-s-a-a-i.description: Ledesma is a diversified agribusiness and manufacturing firm based in Argentina. It operates in food processing, fossil fuels, bioethanol production, and paper milling. The company is notable for its wide range of industrial activities within the chemical industry.

la-anonima.name: La Anónima
la-anonima.description: La Anónima is an Argentine supermarket chain operating mainly in the Patagonia region. It is formally known as S.A. Importadora y Exportadora de la Patagonia. The company is part of the retail industry in Argentina.

lineas-aereas-del-estado-lade.name: Líneas Aéreas del Estado (LADE)
lineas-aereas-del-estado-lade.description: Líneas Aéreas del Estado is an airline based in Comodoro Rivadavia, Argentina. Owned by the Argentine government and operated by the Air Force, it provides domestic scheduled services mainly in Patagonia.

lineas-aereas-federales.name: Líneas Aéreas Federales
lineas-aereas-federales.description: Líneas Aéreas Federales S.A. was a state-owned airline based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. It operated domestic services with flights carried out by other local airlines.

la-serenisima.name: La Serenísima
la-serenisima.description: Mastellone Hermanos S.A., known as La Serenísima, is an Argentine dairy company headquartered in General Rodríguez, Buenos Aires Province. Founded in 1929 by Antonino Mastellone, it is jointly owned by Grupo Arcor and the French multinational Danone.

lima-airport-partners.name: Lima Airport Partners
lima-airport-partners.description: Lima Airport Partners S.R.L. is a limited liability company operating Jorge Chávez International Airport in Callao, near Lima, Peru. Founded in 2001, it holds a 30-year concession and is majority owned by Germany's Fraport AG.

latam-airlines-peru.name: LATAM Airlines Peru
latam-airlines-peru.description: LATAM Airlines Perú is the flag carrier airline based in Lima, Peru, and a subsidiary of Chile's LATAM Airlines Group. It operates scheduled domestic and international flights with its main hub at Jorge Chávez International Airport and holds a dominant position in Peru's domestic market.

laser-airlines.name: LASER Airlines
laser-airlines.description: LASER Airlines is a regional airline based in Caracas, Venezuela. It operates scheduled and charter passenger services within Venezuela, the Caribbean, and South America. Its main hub is Simón Bolívar International Airport.

latam-airlines-paraguay.name: LATAM Airlines Paraguay
latam-airlines-paraguay.description: LATAM Airlines Paraguay, officially Transportes Aéreos del Mercosur S.A., is the flag carrier and national airline of Paraguay. It is headquartered in Asunción and operates flights from Silvio Pettirossi International Airport. The airline is a subsidiary of the Chilean LATAM Airlines Group.

latam-airlines-ecuador.name: LATAM Airlines Ecuador
latam-airlines-ecuador.description: LATAM Airlines Ecuador is a subsidiary of LATAM Airlines Group of Chile, based in Quito, Ecuador. It is owned by Translloyd (55%) and LATAM Airlines (45%). The company operates in the airline industry within Ecuador.

linea-aerea-cuencana.name: Línea Aérea Cuencana
linea-aerea-cuencana.description: Línea Aérea Cuencana (LAC) was a regional airline based in Cuenca, Ecuador. The airline ceased all operations in 2018. It operated within the Ecuadorian airline industry.

linea-aerea-amaszonas.name: Línea Aérea Amaszonas
linea-aerea-amaszonas.hq: Santa Cruz de la Sierra, Bolivia
linea-aerea-amaszonas.description: Línea Aérea Amaszonas S.A., later known as Amas Bolivia, was a regional airline based in Bolivia with headquarters in Santa Cruz de la Sierra and an administrative center in La Paz. It operated short-haul passenger flights within Bolivia and to neighboring countries, with its hub at El Alto International Airport.

lacthosa.name: Lacthosa
lacthosa.description: Lacthosa is a Honduran company producing food and beverage products, with a focus on dairy and fruit juices. It is the leading dairy producer in Honduras. The company is based in Honduras.

luxor-air.name: Luxor Air
luxor-air.description: Luxor Air was a privately owned charter airline based in Cairo, Egypt. It operated charter flights mainly to Europe from its main base at Cairo International Airport.

la-costena.name: La Costeña
la-costena.description: Aerotaxis La Costeña S.A. is a regional airline based in Managua, Nicaragua. It operates passenger services from Managua and Bluefields to three domestic destinations. Its main hubs are Augusto C. Sandino International Airport and Bluefields Airport.

la-comer.name: La Comer
la-comer.description: Grupo La Comer is a Mexican holding company of hypermarkets headquartered in Mexico City. It operates several hypermarket brands including La Comer, City Market, Fresko, and Sumesa. These stores have a strong presence in Mexico City and Central Mexico.

las-estrellas.name: Las Estrellas
las-estrellas.description: Las Estrellas is a Mexican commercial broadcast television network owned by TelevisaUnivision. It began official broadcasts on March 21, 1951, and is distributed free-to-air across Mexico through affiliated stations. It is Mexico's most-watched television network and the nation's second-oldest television broadcaster.

la-parisina.name: La Parisina
la-parisina.description: La Parisina is a chain of department stores in Mexico operated by Grupo Parisina S.A de C.V. It sells fabrics, millinery, home decor, embroidery, sewing machines, and rugs. The group began operations in 1933 and currently operates more than 600 stores across Mexico.

lucha-libre-aaa-worldwide.name: Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide
lucha-libre-aaa-worldwide.description: Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide, commonly known as AAA, is a Mexican professional wrestling promotion based in Mexico City. Founded as Asistencia, Asesoría y Administración de Espectáculos, it is known for its extensive touring schedule dubbed "La Caravana 3 Veces Estelar."

libreria-porrua.name: Librería Porrúa
libreria-porrua.description: Librería Porrúa Hermanos y Compañía S.A. de C.V. is a longstanding bookseller and publishing company in Mexico. Known for its flagship bookstore in Mexico City and subsidiary stores nationwide, it has been associated with books and publishing since the early 20th century.

la-poste-burkina-faso.name: La Poste Burkina Faso
la-poste-burkina-faso.description: La Poste Burkina Faso, formerly SONAPOST until 2018, is responsible for postal services in Burkina Faso. Established in 1997, it succeeded the former National Post Office and Burkina Faso is a member of the West African Postal Conference.
